purpose: Add one unit of a simple product to the guest cart from a category listing (quick add button, hover on a product card).

query.name: forceredirection
query.description: UI sends False. With True a successful add answers {redirect:"/cart"} instead of {success,message}; the product is still added.

contentType: none (body-less POST; needs an empty body, otherwise HTTP 411; header X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest sent by UI)

bodyFields.name: (none)
bodyFields.description: Quantity is always 1. A quantity parameter in the query or in the body is ignored (verified, count rose by 1 each time).

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true, message:"The product has been added to your shopping cart"}; with forceredirection=True: JSON {redirect:"/cart"}

failure.bodySignal: Unknown id: {success:false, message:{TextHint:"Products.NotFound", Args:[id], Text:"The product with ID <id> was not found"}} (message is an object, not a string). Gift card or product with required attributes (e.g. id 63 Ball Chair): {redirect:"/<product-slug>"} and nothing is added. GET: HTTP 404.

additionalEvidence.note: Used to seed carts with products 1 and 5; works the same. Gift card id 20 answers {redirect:"/10-virtual-gift-card"} and adds nothing (cart-add saw the same for gift card id 21). Replayed with curl, own UA.

purpose: Add a simple product with a chosen quantity to the guest cart from its product page (Add to cart button); cart type 1 is the cart, 2 is the wishlist.
contentType: application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8 (X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest sent by UI; an empty body '' also works)

bodyFields.name: addtocart_{productId}.EnteredQuantity
bodyFields.description: Quantity, integer 1..10000. UI sends this name on the add request. The name addtocart_{productId}.AddToCart.EnteredQuantity (form input name, used by updateproductdetails and by the gift card add) is also accepted. Absent field defaults to 1; empty, 0, negative, decimal, non-numeric or a value above int range fail.

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true} (no message). Adding the same product again MERGES into the existing line (quantity summed, same cart item id); CartItemsCount counts units, not lines.

failure.bodySignal: success:false with message array: ["Quantity should be positive"] for 0, -1, abc, 1.5, empty, 99999999999; ["The maximum quantity allowed for purchase is 10000."] for 10001 and also when line quantity plus added quantity exceeds 10000; ["Please select 'Material'.", ...] for a product with required attributes (id 63). Unknown product id 99999999: {redirect:"/"}. Non-numeric or 0 product id: HTTP 404 HTML. GET: HTTP 404. POST without any body: HTTP 411.

note: Same method and path as EP-CART-ADD-GIFTCARD; the body decides (regular product vs gift card form fields). cart-remove and cart-codes used it only to seed their own carts (in their flows.md, not in their endpoints.json).
unverifiedParts: successful add of a product with required attributes (only the failure for id 63 was checked, attribute field names not captured)
destination of cart type 9 (answers success:true, no counter changed)

additionalEvidence.note: Empty body adds 1; adding the same product merges into the existing line (same line id, quantity +1).

Product ids used: 4 Certina $479, 21 $25 Virtual Gift Card, 6 Titleist Pro V1x $2.10, 8 Supreme Golfball $1.90, 14 High School Game Basketball $29.95. For a gift card the form quantity wins over the /1 in the path (2 cards gave a $50 subtotal).
Quantity 3 added with form field addtocart_4.EnteredQuantity=3 (flow 6).
Success body carries a $type field: {"$type":"...","success":true}; use toMatchObject.

purpose: Add a virtual gift card to the cart with recipient and sender details (same URL as the product add, different body).

bodyFields.name: giftcard{productId}-0-.RecipientName
bodyFields.description: Failure message: Enter valid recipient name. Blank/whitespace rejected; 500 chars accepted.

bodyFields.name: giftcard{productId}-0-.RecipientEmail
bodyFields.description: Failure message: Enter valid recipient email. Rejected: empty, notanemail, a@b, address with a space.

bodyFields.name: giftcard{productId}-0-.SenderName
bodyFields.description: Failure message: Enter valid sender name.

bodyFields.name: giftcard{productId}-0-.SenderEmail
bodyFields.description: Failure message: Enter valid sender email.

bodyFields.name: giftcard{productId}-0-.Message
bodyFields.description: Optional; empty ok, 5000 chars accepted (no length limit seen).

bodyFields.name: addtocart_{productId}.AddToCart.EnteredQuantity
bodyFields.description: Quantity 1..10000, same rules as the regular product add.

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true}. Identical recipient/sender/message details merge into the existing line (qty 2, $50.00 for two $25 cards); any difference in the details creates a NEW line (own cart item id).

failure.bodySignal: JSON {success:false, message:[...]}: all invalid fields are listed at once, e.g. ["Enter valid recipient name","Enter valid recipient email","Enter valid sender name","Enter valid sender email"] for an empty form or a body-less POST; quantity errors as in EP-CART-ADD-PRODUCT. Nothing is added.

unverifiedParts: other gift card ids ($10 id 20, $50, $100) not probed
whether a different Message alone creates a new line (only RecipientName was varied)
where the Message text is shown in the cart

additionalEvidence.note: Posted the same gift card form (id 21) to seed carts. A gift-card-only cart (2 x $25) shows Subtotal $50.00, Shipping row text "Not required", Tax $0.00, Total $50.00, and no "Estimate shipping" panel. A mixed cart (gift card + Certina x2) shows Shipping $0.00 and keeps the panel. Listed in the totals unit under EP-CART-ADD-PRODUCT.

purpose: Return the header counters (cart lines/quantity, wishlist, compare); the cart page calls it after every removal to refresh the badges.

query.name: cart
query.description: True to include CartItemsCount; when omitted/False CartItemsCount comes back 0 (the UI sends cart=True and wishlist=True in two separate calls after a remove).

query.name: compare
query.description: True to include CompareItemsCount (sent only by the page-load variant).

success.bodySignal: JSON {CartItemsCount, WishlistItemsCount, CompareItemsCount} ($type AnonymousType37). CartItemsCount is the SUM OF QUANTITIES (lines Certina x3 + Tissot x1 = 4), unlike cartItemCount in the delete response which counts lines. Empty cart: 0.

failure.bodySignal: No failure observed; flags not set return 0 for that counter. The query flags (wishlist=True without cart=True returns CartItemsCount 0) were observed from the browser, only the full cart=True&wishlist=True&compare=True and cart=True variants were replayed with curl.

additionalEvidence.note: CartItemsCount = sum of quantities over all lines (a line of qty 4 counts 4). GET answers 404.
CartItemsCount 10005 for lines 3 + 10000 + 2. Body-less POST without Content-Length answers 411.
Called by the page after every cart action.

purpose: Return the off-canvas mini-cart HTML that the UI shows after an add (success alert with product name, line items, qty input, remove link).
contentType: none (body-less POST; empty body, X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest)

success.bodySignal: text/html fragment with div.offcanvas-cart-item per line; right after a UI add it starts with an alert 'The product name has been successfully added to your cart' (the alert was not reproduced by a bare curl call, only items listed). Line input data-sci-id is the cart item id.

failure.bodySignal: No failure seen; GET also answers 200.

additionalEvidence.note: Empty cart: fragment shows "Shopping cart empty" / "You have not added any product to your cart yet." (class no-items).

purpose: Product page helper: recompute price/stock/variant partials when the quantity or gift card fields change (the UI fires it on each field blur before Add to cart).

bodyFields.name: addtocart_{productId}.AddToCart.EnteredQuantity

success.bodySignal: JSON with Partials{Attrs,Price,...}, Stock, TierPrices, Variants, GalleryHtml. Does not change the cart (count stays the same).

purpose: Render the shopping cart page as server-side HTML including the totals table (Subtotal, Shipping, Tax, Total) of the visitor's own cart.

success.bodySignal: HTML with <div id="order-totals"> rows cart-summary-subtotal / cart-summary-shipping / cart-summary-tax / cart-summary-total; per line input name=itemquantity<cartItemId>; 'Your Shopping Cart is empty!' alert when no lines; an empty-cart page has no totals table and no Estimate shipping panel

additionalEvidence.note: Each line carries data-href="/shoppingcart/deletecartitem?cartItemId=<id>" (data-action="remove", data-name=<product name>). Empty cart: "Your Shopping Cart is empty!", no Checkout button, no totals table.
Qty input has data-sci-item=<lineId>, data-min=1, data-max=10000, data-step=1, data-href=/shoppingcart/updatecartitem?sciItemId=<lineId>&isCartPage=True.
Per line: input[name=itemquantity<id>] with data-sci-item, span.price line total, td.cart-summary-value subtotal.

purpose: Remove one line from the visitor's shopping cart (the "x" link on /cart) and get back the re-rendered cart rows and totals as JSON.

query.name: cartItemId
query.description: Cart line id (the sci id from data-href of the remove link on /cart, NOT the product id). Integer. May also be sent as a form body field cartItemId (verified: model-bound from either place). Lines are scoped to the caller's own cart: an id of another visitor's cart answers success:false and leaves that cart untouched. Missing, empty, non-numeric or > int32 value gives 502 Bad Gateway.

contentType: none (empty body; body-less POST needs data '' / Content-Length: 0, otherwise 411). Optional application/x-www-form-urlencoded with cartItemId=<id>

bodyFields.name: cartItemId
bodyFields.description: Alternative to the query parameter; verified to remove the line when sent as form body with no query string.

success.bodySignal:
JSON {success:true, message:"The product has been removed.", cartItemCount:<number of LINES left, not the quantity sum>, cartHtml:<HTML of remaining cart rows, "


" when empty>, totalsHtml:<HTML of the Subtotal/Shipping/Tax/Total table; Subtotal cell is empty when the cart is empty>, displayCheckoutButtons:true}. $type is AnonymousType32.

failure.bodySignal: Business failure (already-removed id, unknown id, 0, -1, id of another visitor's cart): HTTP 200 JSON {success:false, message:"An error occurred during the removal of the product.", displayCheckoutButtons:true} (AnonymousType30, no cartItemCount/cartHtml/totalsHtml). Technical failure (cartItemId missing, empty, 'abc', 99999999999): HTTP 502 text/html Bad Gateway. GET: 404 HTML 'The resource cannot be found.'. POST without any body/Content-Length: 411 Length Required.

additionalEvidence.note:
Last line removed: cartItemCount 0 and cartHtml "


" (same as cart-remove).
Response is an anonymous type with 6 fields (success, message, cartItemCount, cartHtml, totalsHtml, displayCheckoutButtons), matching cart-remove.
Cleanup call answered {cartItemCount:0, success:true, message:"The product has been removed.", ...}.

purpose: Sets the quantity of one cart line and returns the refreshed line HTML, totals HTML and subtotal.

query.name: sciItemId
query.description: cart line id (shopping cart item id) from the data-sci-item attribute of the qty input on /cart

bodyFields.name: newQuantity
bodyFields.description: integer 1..10000; 0 or negative deletes the line (and answers 500); non-numeric/empty/>2147483647 gives 502

bodyFields.name: isCartPage
bodyFields.description: as sent by the page; also on query string (isCartPage=True)

bodyFields.name: isWishlist
bodyFields.description: as sent by the page

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true, SubTotal:'$958.00 excl tax', message:[], cartHtml, totalsHtml, displayCheckoutButtons:true, newItemPrice:'$479.00 excl tax'}; has $type field

failure.bodySignal: above max (10000): HTTP 200 + success:false + message ['The maximum quantity allowed for purchase is 10000.'], quantity unchanged, SubTotal of the old cart. Unknown/foreign sciItemId: HTTP 500 JSON {error:true,controller:'shoppingcart',action:'updatecartitem',message:'Object reference not set to an instance of an object.'}. newQuantity 0 or negative: same HTTP 500 body AND the line is deleted. Non-numeric, empty, decimal, 1e2, missing newQuantity or sciItemId, >2147483647: HTTP 502 text/html Bad Gateway (line unchanged). Body-less POST: 411. GET: 404.

additionalEvidence.note: newItemPrice is the UNIT price for the new quantity (tier price: High School Game Basketball $29.95 up to qty 5, $24.90 from qty 6). Quantity 1000 accepted; mixed cart Certina x3 + basketball + golf ball + Titleist = $1,470.95. Failure replays 10001 / 0 / -1 / abc / 2.5 match cart-quantity exactly.
